Programming Questionnaire    
 
We are interested in your background, thoughts, feelings, and experience with computer programming and how you study/learn computer programming and in general. 
 
Please answer these questions as honestly as you can. There are no right or wrong answers—we only want to know what you think and feel about programming and other aspects of life that could be related to studying at a college-level with the support of technology.   

Answers will have no impact on grading and will only be used for research purposes and the responses will be ANONYMIZED.
